svg.title: Five retained tower meshes, cut at half their model height
svg.desc: Each panel shows an exact horizontal intersection through its saved mesh at half height. The thin lines are intersected mesh faces. The blue perimeter is the convex hull of those cut points. All five panels use the same centimetre scale.
svg.text: At half height, five different sections.
EXACT MESH/PLANE INTERSECTION · COMMON XY SCALE · MODEL CENTIMETRES
10 cm · BLUE: SECTION POINT ENVELOPE · THIN: CUT MESH FACES
